text: How many staff minutes went to incident cases for Cedar Gold customers who had at least one completed checkout? Count a case once.
Under the Finance memo that applied on each checkout date, how many cents did Cedar collect net on posted checkouts that came from West CRM accounts and included a PEN?
Subtract Fennel's total posted net collections from Cedar's total posted net collections in cents. Use the applicable policy at the time of each checkout; a negative difference is valid.
How many distinct Cedar Marketplace resellers placed a posted checkout? Use the reseller classification from its marketplace registry.
